title: 初中英语：阅读理解
description: 四课讲上下文词汇、顺序、大意与推断，配短英语篇章；提示双语、篇章英语。
assumptions: 短分级英语篇章；答案由文本支撑。
stage1goal: 从上下文建立词汇与顺序。
vocab-context.title: 上下文猜词
vocab-context.goal: 从周围英语文本推断词义。
vocab-context.reading: 结果分句解释词：“exhausted…所以他坐下休息”意为很累。
vocab-context.worked.prompt: 在“Tom was exhausted after the long run, so he sat down and rested.”中 exhausted 意为？
vocab-context.clue.prompt: “The room was chaotic: toys everywhere.” chaotic 意为…
vocab-context.clue.a.label: 凌乱
vocab-context.clue.b.label: 安静
vocab-context.independent.prompt: “She whispered, so nobody heard.” whispered 意为…
vocab-context.independent.a.label: 喊
vocab-context.independent.b.label: 小声说
vocab-context.c1.prompt: “He was famished, so he ate three bowls.” famished 意为…
vocab-context.c1.a.label: 很饿
vocab-context.c1.b.label: 渴
sequence.title: 故事排序
sequence.goal: 按时间连接词排序事件。
sequence.worked.prompt: 在“First we planted the seed. Then it sprouted. Finally it flowered.”中哪个事件最后？
sequence.order.f.label: 开花
sequence.order.p.label: 种植
sequence.order.s.label: 发芽
sequence.transfer-order.prompt: 排序：finally we ate／then we cooked／first we bought。
sequence.transfer-order.e.label: 最后吃
sequence.transfer-order.c.label: 然后煮
sequence.transfer-order.b.label: 先买
sequence.c1.prompt: 哪个连接词标记最后事件？
sequence.c1.a.label: first
sequence.c1.b.label: finally
main-idea.title: 找大意
main-idea.goal: 在英语中区分大意与细节。
main-idea.reading: 大意覆盖所有句：“Bees are useful”覆盖授粉/蜜/喂幼。
main-idea.struggle: 不列细节，解释如何找英语段落大意。
main-idea.worked.prompt: 在“Bees pollinate flowers, make honey, and feed their young. Bees are useful insects.”中为什么“Bees are useful”是大意？
main-idea.main.a.label: 蜜蜂有用
main-idea.main.b.label: 蜜蜂酿蜜
main-idea.transfer-main.prompt: “Rain fills rivers, waters crops, cools air.” 大意？
main-idea.transfer-main.a.label: 雨凉空气
main-idea.transfer-main.b.label: 雨帮助生命
main-idea.c1.a.label: 覆盖全段
main-idea.c1.b.label: 列每个细节
inference.title: 推断作者意图
inference.goal: 超越字面英语推断语气与意图。
inference.reading: 语气与细节选择揭示意图：安静森林＋斧声＝哀悼失去。
inference.worked.prompt: 在“The forest quieted; only axes echoed. The birds had gone.”中作者感受？
inference.intent.prompt: “Recycle: cans become bikes, paper becomes boxes.” 意图？
inference.intent.a.label: 鼓励回收
inference.intent.b.label: 警告自行车
inference.transfer-intent.a.label: 赞扬伐木
inference.transfer-intent.b.label: 哀悼森林消失
inference.c1.a.label: 仅标题
inference.c1.b.label: 语气与细节
inference.c2.a.label: 鼓励
inference.c2.b.label: 警告
